999008199.text: まさか、こんな結果になろうとは……

localizations.en: To think it would turn out like this...

999008199.text: ふ……私が間違っていたということなんだろうね

localizations.en: Heh... I guess I was wrong after all.

999008199.text: それでは、ユナの生徒会長当選を祝って！

localizations.en: Now then, let's celebrate Juna's election as student council president!

999008199.text: かんぱーい！
あ、ありがとう……私のためにこのような会を

localizations.en: Th-thank you... To think you'd throw a gathering like this for me...

999008199.text: 当たり前だよ！

今祝わずしていつ祝うのか！
おめでとうございます、先輩！

localizations.en: If not now, when else would we celebrate? Congratulations, Miss Juna!

999008199.text: 本当に、よくやったと思います
はい！　私たちも協力した甲斐がありました

localizations.en: Yes! All our efforts paid off!

999008199.text: 勝利演説も素敵でしたよ！

localizations.en: Your victory speech was wonderful too!

999008199.text:
票を入れなかった人にも配慮するあたり、
さすがユナさんって感じだったなー

localizations.en: The way you acknowledged even those who didn't vote for you... That was classic Juna right there.

999008199.text:
うん、夢を持つ人は理想の姿だって！
ねえミミ！

localizations.en: Yeah, saying that people with dreams are the ideal! Right, Mimi?

999008199.text:
か、からかわないでください……！
というか、私はユナ先輩に入れたんですけど

localizations.en: D-don't tease me like that...! Besides, I actually voted for Miss Juna.

999008199.text:
え、そうだったの！？
てっきりロマンさんに入れたのかと……

localizations.en: What, really?! I was so sure you voted for Roman!

999008199.text:
まあ、公約に納得できないところはありましたけど……
それでも、生徒会長に相応しいのは先輩だと思ったので

localizations.en: Well, I didn't completely agree with all her campaign promises... But I still thought she was the most suitable person for student council president.

999008199.text: そうか……ありがとう

でも、ちょっと寂しくなるねー。生徒会の活動が
始まっちゃったら、部活には来れなくなるでしょ？

localizations.en: It's going to be a bit lonely though. Once your student council duties start, you won't be able to come to club activities anymore, right?

999008199.text: あ、確かに！　でも……仕方ないですよね

localizations.en: Ah, that's true! But... I guess it can't be helped.

999008199.text: ん？　何を言っているんだ？

localizations.en: Hm? What are you talking about?

999008199.text:
生徒会も錬金術部も、両立させるに決まっている
だろう。もちろん、勉学も疎かにするつもりはない

localizations.en: I'll obviously manage both student council and the alchemy club. And of course, I have no intention of neglecting my studies either.

999008199.text: うっそぉ！？　なに？　鉄人……？

localizations.en: No way! What? Are you superhuman or something?

999008199.text: あはは……でも、ユナちゃんらしいね！

localizations.en: Ahaha... That's just like you, Juna!

999008199.text: ユナ先輩！　引き続きご指導お願いします！

localizations.en: Miss Juna! Please continue to guide us!

999008199.text: ああ。よろしくな

localizations.en: Yes. I look forward to it.

999008199.text: （夢がある人。夢が無い人）
（夢破れた人。夢を諦めた人）

localizations.en: (People whose dreams were shattered. People who gave up on their dreams.)

999008199.text:
（ふと、自分は独りなんじゃないかって
　思うこともあるかもしれない）

localizations.en: (Sometimes you might feel like you're all alone.)

999008199.text:
（そんな時は、周りを見渡してみて。
　気付いてないだけで、ほら）

localizations.en: (When that happens, just look around. You might not realize it, but...)

999008199.text: （あなたの仲間が、そこにいる）

localizations.en: (Your friends are right there beside you.)
